 Abdul El-Sayed Makes a Splash in New Ad “Pool,” Airing During Michigan Football Game
 October 24, 2026 
 “Working Families Are Drowning, And I’m Hopping In To Help”  
 MICHIGAN – Today, Dr. Abdul El-Sayed’s campaign released a new ad “ Pool ”, which aired today during the University of Michigan football game against Indiana. 
 Filmed poolside, El-Sayed fishes money, prescription bottles, and toy yachts out of the water as he criticizes Rogers’ record, all while circling Mike Rogers floating on an inflatable hundred-dollar bill.
 The ad underscores the central contrast of the race: Rogers’ corruption and ties to corporate interests versus El-Sayed’s career cleaning up broken systems while fighting to lower costs for Michigan families.
 WATCH “Pool” HERE   
 Radio : Mike Rogers who lost in 2024 is running again. Rogers cashed out after Congress, making millions, with a mansion in Florida. 
 Abdul El-Sayed : Mike Rogers is everything we hate about a politician.  
 While Michigan struggled in a rigged economy. 
 Mike Rogers sold us out. A multi million dollar payday in Florida? 
 I guess that’s what you can buy when your only answer to a corporation is your name: Roger! 
 Mike’s been in politics for 30 years. 
 He’s done well, we’ve done worse 
 Never met a war or a bad trade deal he didn’t like.  
 Took more pharma money than 95% of congress 
 A multi-million dollar payday. A Florida mansion. Two yachts. 
 My story’s a little bit different.  
 I’ve spent my career cleaning up after politicians like Mike Rogers.  
 I became a doctor to help people 
 Reformed broken systems. Fought opioids and government waste. 
 We’re going to get money out of politics. And in your pocket with lower costs 
 I’ll take on the powerful like Big Pharma, I’ll fight for better jobs and healthcare. And clean up Washington.  
 Politicians like Mike, have let us all down for way too long.  
 I’m Abdul El Sayed. I approve this message because working families are drowning and I’m hopping in to help.
